main_text.p: opusculo de pænis pœnitentibus infli-gendis enunciat, ex Codicibus Vatica-nis exscriberentur, eaqve ad te deferen-da Patri Germano, qvi tuas mihi reddi-dit litteras, consignavi; ex scriptorum Græcorum inopia sive socordia, qvæ non nisi magno pretio in Vaticanum expel-litur, in causa fuit, ut hoc tempus o-mne, ante qvam voluntati obtempera-retur tuæ, insumeretur, qvod brevissi-mum fuerit, si tempora expendas, & qvi-bus hæc nostra Europæ pars urgetur in-commoda. Si qvid ergo interim opus est, impera: ero memor & diligens, ut qvæ imperes, compareant. Vale mi Mo-rine, Vale, & tuum Leonem, tui obse-qventissimum, ut facis, ama.
main_text.head: EPIST. LXIX.
main_text.p: Li-bros, qvos tunc meditabatur, edendos memorat; inter qvos aliqvi sunt non-

page.notes: The right edge of the last lines is damaged by a stain and show-through; "sunt" is partly obscured but read as printed. The date line is read as cIↄ Iↄ CXLIV, rendered MDCXLIV. The paragraph on this page continues onto the next page after "non-".
